name: enX Group Limited
source: Yahoo Finance FY2026 column added 19 Nov 2026 from enX Group Limited summarised group financial results for the year ended 31 August 2026, audited by KPMG Inc. with an unmodified opinion, approved by the board on 12 November 2026, in South African rand. Figures from the summarised group statement of profit or loss, statement of financial position and statement of cash flows, stored x1,000,000: revenue 104.790m, cost of sales 86.604m, gross profit 18.186m, operating expenses 55.528m plus the 0.449m impairment reversal and write-off charge on trade receivables so that gross profit less operating expenses equals the printed operating loss of 37.791m, net finance income 25.436m (stored as a negative cost), loss before tax 12.355m, taxation 9.952m, continuing operations loss after tax 22.307m. The group completed the disposal of its Chemicals business during the year and classified the New Way Power Sale Business and the enX Ventures Letting Enterprise as discontinued operations under IFRS 5 from 1 June 2026, so the printed statement shows continuing operations above the discontinued operations line: Net Profit and EPS here are the TOTAL group figures, a loss of 62.029m and 34.2 cents per share, of which 39.722m came from discontinued operations. That is why profit before tax less income tax equals the continuing loss after tax of 22.307m rather than the total, and it is the same basis the FY2025 column already carries (loss before tax 15.088m less tax 5.819m gave 9.269m for continuing operations while the total loss was 168.409m). Revenue and the expense lines are CONTINUING operations, because the audited statement presents only continuing operations above the discontinued line; the company re-presented the FY2025 comparative to the same basis, at revenue 142.763m and a loss after tax of 6.028m continuing, so the FY2026 to FY2025 revenue comparison in this file is between the originally reported FY2025 total of 378.355m and the FY2026 continuing 104.790m and overstates the decline.
periods_note: columns dropped: FY2021 - no row in this file carries a figure for them, so they rendered as pure dashes
